identity.title: Include pinned Ruby runtime in the immutable AWS Spot builder image

values.task_boundary: Issue 22 only: builder Ruby availability and fail-closed preflight.
deliverables: Ruby preflight and repository validator smoke
Focused positive and missing-Ruby regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: The builder image pins Ruby to an explicit version and verifies the official source archive SHA-256
Ruby version and provenance are recorded in the immutable toolchain manifest
Builder preflight executes ruby --version, a minimal Ruby expression, and one repository Ruby validator smoke before the requested validation command
A missing or unusable Ruby runtime fails builder preflight and prevents the requested validation command
Existing Rust, nextest, sccache, LLD, AWS CLI, architecture, cache, and immutable image checks remain intact
Focused shell contracts, diff hygiene, independent review, and required GitHub checks pass
dependencies: WP-03 AWS Spot builder path is present on current main
non_goals: No dynamic Ruby installation on Spot hosts
No AWS execution or image publication in this issue
No changes to unrelated CI, lifecycle tooling, or other sprints
